issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
How fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa has risen over the last twenty years, from NOAA's own annual means.

Download NOAA GML's annual mean CO2 for Mauna Loa (https://gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_annmean_mlo.csv) during the work; do not type the numbers in. Keep the file as downloaded. Fit an ordinary least squares line of the annual mean on the year over the last twenty years in the file with statsmodels (`statsmodels.api.OLS`), and keep the script that does it.

Report: `report/report.md`, one paragraph: the URL, the time the file was fetched and its SHA-256, the last year in the file, and the fitted slope in ppm per year with its 95% confidence interval as statsmodels reports it. No figure.
issue.title: Research objective
